whenToUse: A security or compliance ledger: sign-ins, permission changes, exports, deletions with actor, IP and severity.
Admin settings pages where investigators filter and expand events.
avoidWhen: Friendly record history for everyday users — use Activity timeline.
Content revisions with restore — use Version history.
a11y: Expandable rows use buttons with aria-expanded; severity is spelled out, not colour-only.
Timestamps show the time zone explicitly.
